0x80011d04.name: end_entry
0x80011d04.evidence: END.EXE's entry (its header): $gp = 0x80037498 and a jump to end_main

0x800119b8.name: end_main
0x800119b8.evidence: the set-up (the heap at 0x80100000, CdInit, end_graphics, the two environments put) and the sequence: overlay_arg 2 plays movies 0 and 1 and holds sixty VSyncs, then movie 2 for any; next_exe and overlay_arg 0, 0x8001c08c, CdControl(8) and a loop on itself. tools/ending.py main_check runs it from the entry, 12 of 12 overlay_args

0x80011ae0.name: end_graphics
0x80011ae0.evidence: ResetGraph(0), SetGraphDebug(0), the two draw and display environments of 320 by 240 at y 0 and 240, clear on and black, SetDispMask(1)

0x80011d14.name: end_play_movie
0x80011d14.evidence: (i): the three counts at 0x80011000 and names at 0x8001100c copied to the stack, the file searched (0x800175b4; not found, nothing), end_movie_rect(i), and a frame decoded at a time until the counter at $gp+8 passes the count or the loop has gone round more than it; CdControl(9). No pad read: the ending cannot be skipped. tools/ending.py play_check, 9 of 9

0x80011f64.name: end_movie_rect
0x80011f64.evidence: (i): the decoder's buffers and the picture's rectangles -- movie 0 320x176 at y 32 and 272, the others 320x240 at y 0 and 240 -- at 0x8009b0dc. tools/ending.py rect_check, 6 of 6
